newsitem.title: PERU: Peru sets $40 mln base price for electric sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru sets $40 mln base price for electric sale.

text.p: The Peruvian government has fixed a $40 million base price for the October 2 privatization of its 80 megawatt (MW) electricity generator Empresa Electrica de Piura S.A.

Jean Delboy, head of state electricity company Electroperu's privatization committee, said eight groups had pre-qualified to hand in bids for the generator, which is based in the northern region of Talara.

The companies who have pre-qualified are Enron Energy of Peru, a unit of Enron Peru's Consorcio Piuragen; AES Peru SRL; Consorcio Peruvian Gas and Electric Company; the local Electrificadora Uno S.A.; a consortium of IES International Inc. and local Electrocahua S.A.; Spain's Endesa ELE.MCu, and a consortium of Enserch Development Corporation, Abengoa of Spain and Orgres of Russia.
The eventual buyer of the generator - currently owned by Electroperu - will have to increase capacity by 150 megawatts within one year.
-- Andrew Cawthorne, Lima newsroom, 221-2134 REUTER AC
